mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate above 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% reflects a weak labor market, suppressing consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 2.0% signals manufacturing sector deterioration, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 2.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a deepening economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 1.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 1.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 500 thousand units) boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 500.
